headword: {国際|こくさい}{連合|れんごう}

definitions.explanation: The formal Japanese name for the United Nations, the international organization founded in 1945. In everyday use, the abbreviation 国連 (こくれん) is far more common.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{連合|れんごう}に{加盟|かめい}する。
{国際|こくさい}{連合|れんごう}の{本部|ほんぶ}はニューヨークにある。
examples.english: The headquarters of the United Nations is in New York.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{連合|れんごう}は{世界|せかい}の{平和|へいわ}と{安全|あんぜん}の{維持|いじ}を{目的|もくてき}として{設立|せつりつ}された。
examples.english: The United Nations was established with the purpose of maintaining world peace and security.

notes:
USAGE:
The full formal name. In news, conversation, and most written contexts, the abbreviation {国連|こくれん} is standard. The full form appears in official documents, textbooks, and formal writing.

FORMS:
- {国連|こくれん} (UN) — the commonly used short form

RELATED ORGANIZATIONS:
- {国連|こくれん}{安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう}{理事会|りじかい} (UN Security Council)
- {国連|こくれん}{総会|そうかい} (UN General Assembly)
- {国連|こくれん}{事務|じむ}{総長|そうちょう} (UN Secretary-General)
